verdict.rationale: Fastmail's 'Filters & Rules' feature lets users define conditions on incoming mail that trigger actions (move, forward, delete, etc.), which satisfies a basic version of this story, and JMAP's API/push capabilities mean an AI agent could programmatically create or react to such rules. However, evidence doesn't show event-driven automation beyond mail filtering (e.g., no multi-step workflows, no cross-service triggers, no rule chaining) and community notes filters/rules are hard even to migrate, suggesting limited sophistication. Missing for 10: documentation of complex/multi-condition automation, API-driven rule creation/management specifically, and independent evidence of AI-native automation depth beyond basic filters.
